gloss: as before; as usual; as has been the case

definitions.gloss: as before; as usual; in the same way as before
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something continues in the same manner as it has been done previously. Used to state that no change has been or will be made.

examples.japanese: ⟦{営業時間|えいぎょうじかん}→営業時間：18476_eigyoujikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{従来通|じゅうらいどお}りです。
examples.english: Business hours remain the same as before.

examples.japanese: {従来通|じゅうらいどお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{進|すす}めましょう→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's proceed in the same way as before.

examples.japanese: ⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{従来通|じゅうらいどお}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even though the system has changed, the procedures remain the same as before with no modifications.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{従来|じゅうらい}→従来：12511_juurai⟧ (conventional, traditional, up to now) + {通|どお}り (as, in accordance with). The suffix ～{通|どお}り attaches to nouns to mean "in the same way as."

COMMON PATTERNS:
Functions as an adverb or as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {従来通|じゅうらいどお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧ (the same method as before).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {従来通|じゅうらいどお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ (the same response as before)
- {従来通|じゅうらいどお}り⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (remains unchanged)

USAGE:
Common in business, administrative, and formal contexts. Often used in announcements to clarify that something has not changed despite other changes.
